planSteps.description: The site is password-protected. Find the password input field on the page and enter 'My-Drop-Site', then submit to unlock the site.
After entering the password, verify the homepage loads with the main content, navigation, and product sections visible.
Click the Shop or Products link in the navigation and verify the product listing page loads with product cards visible.
Click on a product card and verify the product detail page opens with image, price, and description.
Click the Add to Cart or Select Size button on a product page and verify the cart icon updates or a confirmation appears.
Scroll to the bottom of the page and verify the footer is visible with links and copyright info.
